title: A set agreeing near x with the affine plane x + Q has Q as approximate tangent space at x (parent step 3e)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be measurable, x ∈ ℝ^P, Q ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with finrank Q = n, and r > 0. Suppose M ∩ B_r(x) = {y : y − x ∈ Q} ∩ B_r(x), where B_r(x) is the open ball. Then HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q holds (Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4): finrank Q = n and, for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), ∫_{η_{x,ρ}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as ρ ↓ 0. Here η_{x,ρ}(y) = ρ⁻¹(y − x) is blowUpMap x ρ and Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (r : ℝ), MeasurableSet M → Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → 0 < r → M ∩ ball x r = {y | y - x ∈ Q} ∩ ball x r → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q
